who: Historian of modern Britain, at Florida State University around 2000 and later SUNY Fredonia.

notes: The candidate’s expanded name is documented at the student’s institution near the dissertation year; publication metadata confirms the ORCID identity.

who: David I. Macleod, historian of American childhood at Central Michigan University; Wisconsin–Madison doctorate, 1972–1973.

evidence.says: The University of Wisconsin Press author biography identifies David I. Macleod as professor of history at Central Michigan University and author of Building Character in the American Boy.
Lists David Macleod’s doctorate in 1972–1973, with a dissertation on Boy Scouts, Boys’ Brigades and YMCA boys’ work.
Authority n83005398 identifies David I. Macleod as the author of Building Character in the American Boy.
The alternative D. Peter MacLeod is a historian of colonial North America and Canadian War Museum curator, author of The Canadian Iroquois and the Seven Years’ War.

notes: Institution, doctorate period and works identify David I. Macleod; D. Peter MacLeod is a different candidate.
